recentItems.title: House GOP conference chair says Max Miller is "our nominee right now" despite abuse allegations
recentItems.description:
Michigan Rep. Lisa McClain, who is the House GOP conference chair, told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that "I wish" the abuse allegations against Ohio Republican Rep. Max Miller "aren't true," but "he's our nominee right now." Miller is up for reelection this fall, but several prominent Republicans have declined to support him.

recentItems.title: Sunoco board chair says gas prices are "painful," but "people are still filling their cars up"
recentItems.description:
Ray Washburne, the board chairman of Sunoco and the chair of next week's Republican midterm convention, called gas prices "painful," but he noted that "the refineries are turning more" oil out for consumers. "People are filling their cars up and they're still driving," he said.

recentItems.title: Rep. Jason Crow says Congress hasn't been briefed on Hegseth leak investigation
recentItems.description:
Rep. Jason Crow, who sits on both the House Intelligence and the House Armed Services Committees, told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that Congress has not been briefed on a Pentagon leak investigation helmed by Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. He added that the investigation is "part of his effort to create fear and clamp down on information coming out of the Pentagon."

recentItems.title: Energy Secretary Chris Wright says "we are always open" for a nuclear agreement with Iran
recentItems.description:
As gas prices continue to rise in the U.S., Energy Secretary Chris Wright told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that "we are always open" to a nuclear agreement, and that President Trump's goal has always been to "not use a military solution unless absolutely necessary."
